title: THE SAVIOR WHO COULD NOT BRING SALVATION
overview: Tetsuo Yabusame, an unlikely defender of Earth, heads into a furious battle against 20,000 kaiju.

title: ENCOUNTERS
overview: In search of life in frozen ruins, Tetsuo encounters human survivors that he's been searching for.

title: MY FIRST FRIEND
overview: Tetsuo joins Ao's group, then confronts new intergalactic kaiju alone until who should appear but...

title: THE KAIJU TAMER AND THE CAN OF PINEAPPLE
overview: Tetsuo is welcomed by the survivors at the Mishima Mall. But why is it so warm in a frozen world?

title: GOOD JOB!
overview: A new enemy seeks out the Mishima Mall as a targeted Testsuo visits Hagane's late mother's lab.

title: BEYOND THE MADNESS
overview: Driven by jealousy, a former member of E-RDE commands a merciless attack on Tetsuo and the others!

title: THE COST OF COURAGE
overview: Overwhelmed by the powerful kaiju, Hercules, Tetsuo turns the tide of battle with... Communication!

title: MISHIMA MALL ACTIVATES
overview: The Boss activates a secret defense system against the kaiju, but can the Mall hold out for Tetsuo?

title: THE GREAT KAIJU WAR
overview: Ao returns to the Mall and takes on the enemy while the Boss recounts Sagami's past!

title: WOUNDS YOU CAN FACE
overview: A rematch with Hercules begins. The Mishima Mall vs. VIERDE battle reaches its climax!

title: I WANT TO BE A SAVIOR
overview: After a fierce battling, Tetsuo defeats Hercules. In a daze, Sagami confesses a shocking truth… !

title: A CALM AND GENTLE WORLD
overview: Sagami loses his will to fight. VIERDE's story unfolds their survival during the Big Freeze.

title: DRINK TOGETHER
overview: Turns out Nadare is the humanoid behind the Big Freeze. Tetsuo and Yukio fight the ultimate enemy.
